purpose: Explicit, enforceable Upstash usage budgets for the PaySwap runtime plane (free-tier-first). This record IS the budget data: scripts/deployment/upstash-budget-probe.ts loads it and measures live usage against it. Secret hygiene: env NAMES only — never values; the REST endpoint/token live only in the operator vault.

binding.plan: free tier — single database per account
binding.vaultPosture: operator vault only; the earlier operator-supplied endpoint hostnames are recorded in spec/development-state/runtime-activation.json / runtime-plane-probe.json (polished-yeti-167554.upstash.io was the live binding; meet-ewe-145933.upstash.io was verified NXDOMAIN and never used)
binding.separationPosture: single free-tier database => production/preview separation is NAMESPACE-PREFIX-LEVEL ONLY (unlike Neon branch-level and R2 bucket-level separation). The recorded upgrade path (runtime-activation.json) is a dedicated database per environment once usage justifies it.
binding.namespaceLaw: every key MUST live under the payswap:* namespace prefix; keys outside payswap:* are a budget violation by definition

providerFreeTierCeiling.notes: provider-documented free tier (10,000 commands/day; 256 MB max data size), cross-checked against public provider/pricing references on 2026-10-02; live confirmation against the Upstash console is CREDENTIAL-GATED until the operator vault is re-supplied — recorded values are the budgeting baseline, not a fabricated live reading
providerFreeTierCeiling.headroomPolicy: self-imposed budgets keep >= 20% headroom below every provider ceiling

namespaceInventory.role: taxonomy-validated observability sink written by the hosting plane's ingestion endpoint (W3-007 taxonomy events: terminal transitions, UNKNOWN outcomes, reconciliation, deployment gates)
preview-plane observability sink (same taxonomy, preview correlation)
namespaceInventory.evidence: none yet — required by this posture record for preview/runtime separation symmetry
namespaceInventory.status: required-posture; live presence verification credential-gated, not executed

namespaceInventory.role: TRANSIENT outbox drain-drill stream (XADD/XREADGROUP/XACK/XPENDING probe); must be cleaned up (DEL) by the drill after verification
protocol outbox drain queues for the production plane (topology section 3.1 QUEUE_URL/REDIS_URL consumers: protocol, adapter, reconciliation, notification workers)
namespaceInventory.status: required-posture; live presence verification credential-gated, not executed

namespaceInventory.role: preview-plane outbox drain queues (same shape, preview prefix)
namespaceInventory.status: required-posture; live presence verification credential-gated, not executed

commandClassBudgets.unit: Upstash commands per UTC day (a REST call = 1 command)

perNamespace.cleanupLaw: probe streams must be DELeted by the drill that created them; leftover probe keys are a violation

rateCeilings.notes: self-imposed ceilings to keep the free-tier database responsive and far from any provider throttling behavior; enforcement points are the producers (ingestion endpoint, workers, probe drivers); no repo-side rate limiter meters Upstash commands today — recorded honestly, see enforcement

memoryBudget.notes: 100 MB self-imposed (39% of the 256 MB provider ceiling); streams must stay bounded — the observability stream length is checked by the probe driver against streamLengthCeiling

streamLengthCeilingsNotes: entries; a stream approaching its ceiling requires a trim decision (XTRIM) — trimming observability evidence is a governance decision, never automatic (INV-E05: historical evidence is immutable; the ceiling exists to surface the decision, not to silently delete)

page.condition: any namespace >= 90% of its daily budget, or all-namespace total >= 9000 commands/day, or memory >= 214 MB

alertThresholds.alertingPosture: thresholds are data for the observability plane (W3-007 no-orphan-alerts law: every alert must reference a runbook entry); wiring the alerts to a live channel is credential-gated and NOT executed in this record

honest: The budgets above are ENFORCEABLE AS DATA: the probe driver (scripts/deployment/upstash-budget-probe.ts) loads this record and FAILS (non-zero exit) when a live measurement exceeds a budget or a key outside payswap:* is found.

The producers that generate Upstash traffic are the hosting-plane ingestion endpoint and the worker roles (runtime host + future workers) — their rate limiting is the runtime plane's responsibility, outside this repository's code. This record is the contract they must honor.

No in-repo component currently issues Upstash commands at runtime (packages/* contain no Upstash client); all recorded traffic comes from the deployed runtime plane and operator probes. If that changes, the issuing package must consume this record as its budget.

measurement.gatedBehavior: without credentials the driver prints and (with --record) writes an honest credential-gated measurement record and exits 0 — UNKNOWN is not FAILED; it never fabricates a live reading
liveChecks: SCAN payswap:* inventory (bounded pages) vs namespaceInventory
XLEN per declared stream vs streamLengthCeilings
the probe's own command spend, reported and counted against the budget
measurement.lastExecution: credential-gated, not executed (operator vault lost to sandbox reset 2026-10-02; live execution deferred until the TL re-supplies the vault)
